item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #NLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 FINAL #NLPRSD

All Thunderstorm Advisories over forecast areas are now terminated. However, all are still advised to continue monitoring for updates.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards. Residents along mountain slope are advised for possible landslides mudslides, rockslides and flash flood.

Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #NLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #NLPRSD
Issued at 06:45 PM 12 October 2026

Moderate to occasionally Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Pangasinan(SanCarlosCity, Bugallon, Calasiao, Malasiqui, Alcala, Bautista, Villasis, CityOfUrdaneta, Manaoag, Mapandan, SantaBarbara, Laoac, Binalonan, Asingan, SantaMaria, Balungao, SantoTomas, Rosales, Tayug, Infanta), #Benguet(Buguias), #Ifugao(Aguinaldo, Mayoyao), #MountainProvince(Barlig and Paracelis) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #MountainProvince(Natonin, Sabangan, Bauko, Tadian), #Ifugao(AlfonsoLista, Hungduan, Tinoc, Asipulo), #Benguet(Mankayan, Bakun), #Pangasinan(Mangatarem, Urbiztondo, Basista, Bayambang, Aguilar and SanManuel) which may persist within 30 mins to 1 hour and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards. Residents along mountain slope are advised for possible landslides mudslides, rockslides and flash flood.

Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 24 #NLPRSD
item.description:
Rainfall Advisory No. 24 #NLPRSD
Weather System: Easterlies
Issued at 02:00 PM 12 October 2026

Light to Moderate to at times Heavy rains are expected over #NuevaVizcaya(Kasibu, DupaxDelNorte, AlfonsoCastaneda, DupaxDelSur), #Quirino(Cabarroguis, Aglipay, Saguday), #Benguet(Atok, Bakun, Kapangan, Kibungan, LaTrinidad, Mankayan, Sablan, Tublay, Buguias), #Abra(Boliney, Bucloc, Daguioman, LicuanBaay, Malibcong, Sallapadan, Tubo), #MountainProvince(Besao, Tadian), #Isabela(CityOfSantiago, SanIsidro, Alicia, Angadanan, SanGuillermo, Dinapigue), #Aurora(MariaAurora, Baler and SanLuis) within the next 2 to 3 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Aurora(Dipaculao, Casiguran, Dinalungan, Dilasag), #Quirino(Maddela, Nagtipunan), #Isabela(Echague, Jones and SanAgustin) which may persist within 2 to 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 05:00 PM Today.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards. Residents along mountain slope are advised for possible landslides, mudslides, rockslides and flash flood.

Keep monitoring for updates.
